guidance: Merlot and Noi sparkling wine will begin from Q 2, while Shotgun Strong is expected in H2, so we expect CSD to become an increasingly meaningful contributor through the year.
Wanted to ask with t he RTD sales doubling Y-o-Y, what revenue contribution are we expecting from Shotgun at the year-end FY27?
capex: So given the approximately 20% EBITDA margin guidance, could you help us understand the key levers that will drive this margin expansion?
So as the business both RTD and the bottles business, as you see more scale in the business, you will see these EBITDA expansion in the coming years up to FY2030, which is the guidance we've given.
risks: We delivered robust revenue growth in Q1 despite temporary regulatory challenges in Delhi and Uttar Pradesh.
Delhi was impacted by delays in label registrations while Uttar Pradesh saw some changes in the excise policy during the quarter.
focus: We believe Q1 is an encouraging first st ep towards our objective, and we remain focused on delivering profitable growth as the business scales.
